posts.cooked:
Hi,
In GA 4, question 3 is incorrectly marked by showing a wrong option as one of the correct answers. As a result, my answer is only partially correct as per what I see in the portal
Please see attached the details.

I tried the same question in Ubuntu and have also attached the output for your reference. As per my check, my answer is the correct one.

Please update if the evaluation is incorrect or not.

1000009911775×1280 108 KB

10000099121080×829 55.4 KB

10000099151280×357 47.8 KB

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Yes, [Aa-Zz] is not valid range in BRE or ERE. This should have been [A-Za-z] instead.

Only the cut command would work in this case.

Option (a) is only correct if the range is corrected.

Will let the team know, thanks.
